paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Yishmael, Yehoshua’s sons. And Rabbi Mattanyah; see his entry. [Glosses: Yochanan. (1) Menachot 41b, end, and Zevachim 63a: Rabbi Yochanan ben Beteira; that same matter has Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira. It was not corrected. (2) Bava Batra 87b, beginning: ‘It was stated concerning it: Rabbi Abbahu said, Rabbi Yochanan said.’ This is how it should read, for so Tosafot write at the end of page a, and Chullin 110a, the comment beginning ‘Ikka.’ (3) Sanhedrin 70a: Rabbi Yochanan ben Moladah; there, 71a: Chanan. It was not corrected.]
